title: Partial Combinatory Algebras
abstract: Formalises partial combinatory algebras with the K/S combinators, programming combinators, the free combinatory algebra, and the graph model.

informal.LeanPool.PartialCombinatoryAlgebras.PCA: Defines the class of partial combinatory algebras (PCAs) with K and S combinators.
informal.LeanPool.PartialCombinatoryAlgebras.CA: Defines total combinatory algebras and exhibits every total combinatory algebra as a PCA.
informal.LeanPool.PartialCombinatoryAlgebras.Free: Constructs the free total combinatory algebra as a quotient of formal expressions.
informal.LeanPool.PartialCombinatoryAlgebras.Grap: Constructs the graph-model combinatory algebra on the powerset of any Listing-typed carrier.
